items.prompt: An add creates bid 100 qty 2 and another creates ask 100 qty 3. What does side-separated depth retain?

options.why: The same numeric price on different sides refers to two different aggregate levels.
Combining sides loses the distinction between buy and sell interest.
The task reports resting depth, not a signed net across sides.

options.text: Neither level, because equal prices automatically cancel.
options.why: No matching or cross-side cancellation rule is part of this fold.
